Start date: 1247-01-07  
Subtract 49 weeks = 49 × 7 = 343 days.  
Add 2 more days to subtract: total 345 days before.  
1247-01-07 minus 345 days:  
Go to 1246-12-31 (7 days back to end of 1246), then 338 more days back into 1246.  
1246 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in 1246 before Dec 31: 365 days in year.  
1246-12-31 minus 338 days = 1246-01-27 (since 338 days before Dec 31 is Jan 27? Let’s check: Jan 27 is day 27, so from Jan 27 to Dec 31 = 338 days? Actually 365–338 = 27 → Jan 27).  
Wait, careful:  
From 1247-01-07 subtract 345 days:  
1247-01-07 → 1246-01-07 is 365 days earlier (since 1246 is common year).  
But we need 345 days earlier, which is 20 days *later* than 1246-01-07? That would be 1246-01-27.  
Check: 1247-01-07 minus 365 days = 1246-01-07. We want only 345 days earlier, so 345 = 365 – 20 → so 20 days *after* 1246-01-07 → 1246-01-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1246-01-27
